details: So basically a lot of players are having major issues on their side because it's not really stated in plain sight. Took me a few hours just to end up finding that I could of used 10mins to find the actual solution to my problem. ( So basically there should be a pending feature on uploaded avatars when the security check failed shows up on the avatar rank system on the website. There should be Security Check Pending on avatars that has the question mark on the thumbnail of the avatar so people will know there is a queue like system or pending in short terms. That away people are not going back after a few hours to remove triangles or turn 3 materials into 1 material which is recommended on quest but isn't a major priority or removing Expression Menu and Para to see if the file size is big using toggles and what not. So I spent a little bit of my time to search around to finally find out that there is a Avatar Pending feature that isn't in plain sight. Having a Question mark and an X isn't reasonable fully to the extent that it should be common sense to know its pending. So Maybe when there is a question mark on the thumbnail maybe add a Security Check Pending on the avatar rank section so we know that we don't got to go back and redo things because most people look at the avatar rank section and see Security Check Failed with an X there and think the avatar needs to be fixed when actually its just pending. Anyways I hope this gets fixed and will prevent a ton of players stressing over their avatars security checks failed issue.
title: Add Avatar Upload Pending Feature (Security Check Failed)
